1.consolidated_definition: Árbol de hasta 15 m de altura, de corteza lisa color castaño, grandes hojas elípticas y dentadas y flores de color verde amarillento; su madera se utiliza para leña y para postes. Euphorbiaceae Alchornea latifolia.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Tree reaching a height of up to 15 m, with smooth, chestnut-brown bark, large elliptical and toothed leaves, and yellow-green flowers; its wood is used for firewood and posts. Euphorbiaceae Alchornea latifolia.
